title: Thesis protected-edge correctness
summary: All 14,250 current-version tiny pairs match; 160 local exchange checks and seven Lean lemmas complete. Universal graph correctness remains open.

claims.label: Chapter 6 universal correctness
claims.detail: Root-safe common-cherry path normalization preserving AF and original-edge provenance, plus lifting of residual optimum cutsets through suppression; these imply symmetric two-pendant exchange and inherited optimum exclusion.

claims.label: Exact small-input decisions
claims.detail: All 225 four-leaf pairs, 11,025 five-leaf pairs, and 3,000 six-leaf pairs with seed 613 agree with a separate partition implementation. Same author; no universal claim.

claims.label: Lemma 6.3 source overstatement
claims.detail: Two-label disconnected-source/joined-target counterexample; immediate 6.4/6.5 uses compare against connected T1, so their containment premise is automatic.

lemmas.label: Protected-c A2BC branch logic
lemmas.detail: Kernel checked, no axioms; coverage, exchange and inherited exclusion are explicit hypotheses.

lemmas.label: OR protection provenance
lemmas.detail: Two kernel-checked Boolean path theorems; graph transport is still open.

lemmas.label: Normalization cut-count inequality
lemmas.detail: Kernel checked under explicit count bounds; root-safe AF preservation remains open.
